header.title: P.Oxy. 78 5127: Old Testament, Psalm 90 4-13: AI translation (Claude)
header.author: Greek magical papyri and amulets
header.source: Translated by Claude (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) from the library's urn:magic:dclp:171874:grc, from papyri.info's Digital Corpus of Literary Papyri (CC BY 3.0), one English line for each line of the original. Only some passages are translated so far: those that the Atlas of Ancient Myth, Magic in the Ancient Texts and the demons-and-angels study cite.

notes.2.11: Psalm 90(91):6-7. Line 2.12 begins with the end of πράγματος ('thing'); its first letter is in the lost or illegible traces above. 'In darkness' is written twice (2.12-15), and 'noonday' is absent after 'demon', compared with the usual Greek text. Letters marked doubtful in the edition (2.15-19) are translated as read.
